summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Cho Chi-hyo, a handball player. It records his performance at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, Spain, where he was runner-up for top goal scorer with 45 goals in 6 games. The South Korea national handball team finished 6th at that tournament, and Cho was later named to the competition's All-Star Team.
one_line: Cho Chi-hyo, a South Korean handball player, was runner-up for top scorer at the 1992 Barcelona Olympics.
